'''Onight''' was the name of several establishments on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The exterior featured the name of the establishment, rendered in glowing light [[Color/Legends|pink]] [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] [[Writing/Legends|writing]], with a light green line situated above and beneath the name.<ref name="DoM"/>
